lines.lyric_hangul: 어딘가로 도피 중임 당당했던 내 모습은 어디
lines.lyric_translation: I’m in the middle of escaping to somewhere else / Where is my confident self?

lines.lyric_hangul: All the problems and lot of things make me fool 날 겁쟁이로 만들었지
lines.lyric_translation: All the problems and lot of things / Make me fool, made me a coward

parts.lyric: All the problems and lot of things
Make me fool nal geopjaengiro mandeureotji

lines.lyric_hangul: 날 옥죄어 와 시곗바늘 소리 점점 다가오는 듯해 저기 문틈 사이
lines.lyric_translation: The sound of the clock ticking suffocates me / It feels like it’s getting closer, through that crack in the door

parts.lyric: Jeomjeom dagaoneun deuthae jeogi munteum sai

lines.lyric_hangul: 보여 낭만이 가득하고 자유로워 보이고 사방이 탁 트인
lines.lyric_translation: I see it, a place full of romance and freedom / Wide open on all sides

lines.lyric: Let’s be free mukkyeoitteon paldarireul pureo
lines.lyric_hangul: Let's be free 묶여있던 팔다리를 풀어
lines.lyric_translation: Let’s be free, let loose your tied-up arms and legs
Shout until my voice gives out

lines.lyric_hangul: 항상 잠재워 왔던 내 상상을 이상으로 바꿔줘
lines.lyric_translation: My imagination that I had always put to sleep, / Change it into something beyond it

lines.lyric_hangul: 죽어라 창문 밖 보면서 내뿜던 한숨
lines.lyric_translation: The sighs I used to let out / While endlessly staring out the window

lines.lyric: Geurae keunmam meokgo dallineun chaeseo talju
lines.lyric_hangul: 그래 큰맘 먹고 달리는 차에서 탈주
lines.lyric_translation: Yeah, throw caution to the wind and escape from a moving car

lines.lyric_hangul: Let me be free 내 발목을 잡는 족쇄야 이제 놔줘
lines.lyric_translation: Let me be free, you shackles that chain my ankles / Now let me go

parts.lyric: Let me be free nae balmogeul jamneun jokswaeya

lines.lyric_hangul: 밤하늘에 떠 있는 별들 바라보며 찌푸리던 인상
lines.lyric_translation: With a scowling expression, I look at / The stars in the night sky

lines.lyric_hangul: 시끄러운 알람에 짜증만 가득한데 이제 모두 던질까
lines.lyric_translation: These noisy alarms do nothing but annoy me / Should I throw it all away?
I just want to walk around, to wherever that might be
Away from all the eyes watching me right now,

lines.lyric_hangul: 만큼은 도착지가 어디든지 신경 안 쓰고 악쓰며 맘대로 뛰어
lines.lyric_translation: Without caring what my destination will be, / I’ll run with all my strength, however I want

parts.lyric: Mankeumeun dochakjiga eodideunji shingyeong an sseugo

lines.lyric_translation: Let’s run

lines.lyric: Eodideun summakhiji anneun goseuro ga run
lines.lyric_hangul: 어디든 숨막히지 않는 곳으로 가 run
lines.lyric_translation: Wherever it is, go somewhere that isn’t stifling, run
Hide all the stupid parts of myself and run
Running on the highway
I don’t want to decide my destination

lines.lyric_hangul: 그래 지구상에 나 하나 쉴 곳이 없을까 무작정 두 발로 뛰어나가지 계속 run
lines.lyric_translation: Is there not a single place on earth for me to rest? / Blindly run away with both feet, keep running

parts.lyric: Geurae jigusange na hana shwil goshi eopseulkka
Mujakjeong du ballo ttwieonagaji gyesok run

lines.lyric_translation: Keep running
Run with both feet, keep running
Keep running
Run run yeah
Let’s run run yeah

lines.lyric: Mami ganeun daero pulliji anneun nae piro
lines.lyric_hangul: 맘이 가는 대로 풀리지 않는 내 피로
lines.lyric_translation: My exhaustion won’t go away like I want it to

lines.lyric_hangul: 식겁했지 거울 속에 내 모습은 초췌해 다시 뒤로뒤로뒤로
lines.lyric_translation: I freaked out, my reflection in the mirror is haggard / Again, I push, push, push

parts.lyric: Shikgeophaetji geoul soge nae moseubeun chochwehae

lines.lyric_hangul: 미뤄미뤄미뤄 내일 할 일들 다음으로 pass 싫어 싫어 싫어
lines.lyric_translation: Back, back, back the things I have to do tomorrow / Pass it on to the next time, I don’t like it, like it, like it

lines.lyric_hangul: Neckless 언제부터 무거웠나 어깨에 짐 쏟아내듯 처진 것 봐
lines.lyric_translation: Neckless, since when did it start feeling heavy / Look at how my shoulders sink as if carrying a burden

parts.lyric: Eokkaee jim ssodanaedeut cheojin geot bwa

lines.lyric_hangul: Now stop 잠시 넘어지자 아픈 척이라도 하면 앉아 있어도 될까
lines.lyric_translation: Now stop, let’s fall for a moment / If I pretend to be hurt, will I be able to sit down?

parts.lyric: Apeun cheogirado hamyeon anja isseodo dwelkka

lines.lyric_hangul: 새롭게 시작되는 아침 누군가에게는 상쾌한 새벽 공기가 내겐 무거워
lines.lyric_translation: For someone else, the morning is a new start / But the fresh dawn air weighs heavy on me / Still half-asleep

lines.lyric_hangul: 잠 덜 깬 내 정신은 몽롱해 도통 깰 생각은 안 해 눈만 되려 껌뻑
lines.lyric_translation: My mind is foggy / I have no intention of waking up / I just blink my eyes

lines.lyric_translation: Like a time warp, like going away to somewhere else
I want to throw myself into the wide ocean
Swim leisurely, into the unknown world, swim

Run from my town

Run from the world

lines.lyric: Igoseul tteona naega weonhaneun goseuro Let me go
lines.lyric_hangul: 이곳을 떠나 내가 원하는 곳으로 Let me go
lines.lyric_translation: Leave this place, go where I want to go, let me go

lines.lyric: Jageun bihaenggi sok nallyeo bonaen yeoyu Fly so high
lines.lyric_hangul: 작은 비행기 속 날려 보낸 여유 Fly so high
lines.lyric_translation: The carefreeness I sent off in a little plane, fly so high

lines.lyric: Neomu nopaseo nae sone dajiga anneun geolkka?
lines.lyric_hangul: 너무 높아서 내 손에 닿지가 않는 걸까?
lines.lyric_translation: Is it too high for my hands to reach?
